title: 🎟️ Buy Algonquin day permits (Sat & Sun)
notes: $21/vehicle/day, online or 1-888-668-7275, up to 5 days ahead, not sold at gate, tied to licence plate

title: 💧 Ragged Falls (call first)
notes: Oxtongue River–Ragged Falls, just west of West Gate. Season ended Oct 18; call (705) 789-5105 to confirm lot is open, else skip

title: 🥾 Track and Tower Trail (km 25)
place: Track and Tower Trail, Hwy 60 km 25, Algonquin Provincial Park
notes: 7.5 km, moderate–difficult, ~4 h, lookout over Cache Lake

title: 🕌 Lunch + Dhuhr at Algonquin Visitor Centre (km 43)
notes: Heated, open 9–5 (9–4 in Nov), viewing deck, café snacks only. Qibla ≈55° from north (NE)

title: 🌲 Spruce Bog Boardwalk (km 42.5)
place: Spruce Bog Boardwalk, Hwy 60 km 42.5, Algonquin Provincial Park

title: ⛰️ Lookout Trail (km 39.7) + Asr
place: Lookout Trail, Hwy 60 km 39.7, Algonquin Provincial Park
notes: 2.1 km steep loop, ~1 h, huge view; off trail before dark (~6 PM)

title: 🏔️ Centennial Ridges (km 37.6)
place: Centennial Ridges Trail, Hwy 60 km 37.6, Algonquin Provincial Park
notes: 10.4 km difficult loop, ~6 h, two high ridges; trailhead 2 km south of Hwy 60, access gate may be locked (+2 km each way). Clocks fall back tonight; sunset ~5 PM

title: 🪵 Algonquin Logging Museum trail (km 54.5)
notes: Building closed for season; 1.3 km outdoor trail always open

title: 💦 Bracebridge Falls / Wilson's Falls
notes: Free; Bracebridge Falls downtown, Wilson's Falls trail 500 Wilson's Falls Rd (3.7 km)

title: 🕌 Maghrib at Orillia Muslim Community
place: Orillia Muslim Community, 62 Peter St N, Orillia, Ontario
notes: 62 Peter St N, Orillia (or Barrie Mosque, 155 Ferris Lane)
